P-01.buyer_facing_statement: Computationally verified (svMultiPhysics 3D Navier-Stokes, 16% 1D-3D agreement). Physical prototype validation outstanding. No bench prototype exists. V0 bench buildable from COTS ($3-5K).
P-01.honest_classification: TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (computational). NOT physically validated. Buyer package explicitly states this distinction.

failed_fields: independent_validation (same-author reimplementation only, published cross-check but not external solver execution)
P-15.buyer_facing_statement: Computational model reproducible (deterministic, seed=42). Published reference cross-check confirms harvest assumption (Zurbuchen 2013, 16.7 μW). NOT independently validated by external computational tool. Physical measurement of cardiac harvesting outstanding. 96-point operating envelope is computational robustness, NOT physical validation.
P-15.honest_classification: TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (computational). NOT independently validated. NOT physically validated.

P-16.buyer_facing_statement: Independently validated by ACTUAL PyTissueOptics v2.0.1 (DCC-Lab, different author, pip-installed). Monte Carlo convergence documented (CIs overlap). Published Jacques 2013 range confirmed. PyTissueOptics uses Henyey-Greenstein scattering approximation (limitation preserved in dossier). MCX (GPU gold standard) not executed (CUDA constraint). Experimental tissue measurement outstanding.
P-16.honest_classification: TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (computationally + independently validated). NOT physically validated. HG approximation limitation preserved.

summary.P-16: TTR (independent computational). Physical outstanding. HG limitation preserved.
